meta.name: self-service-and-knowledge
meta.description: Builds the help center, in-product guidance, and knowledge base that let customers resolve problems without contacting anyone — content, findability, maintenance, and deflection measurement. Use this to build or fix a help center, reduce support volume, write documentation for customers, improve findability, or decide what deserves a help article versus a product fix.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建自助帮助中心，让客户自己解决问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想搭建客户自助服务，减少客服工单量
copy.tagline_en: Build a self-service help center so customers solve issues on their own
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to set up customer self-service and cut support volume

howto.what: Claude 会基于联系量排序和搜索日志,撰写或重写帮助文章,设计产品内提示,并制定文档维护与衡量方案。
howto.when: 当用户要求搭建或修复帮助中心、降低客服联系量、编写客户文档等场景触发;也用于判断该写文章还是修产品。

say.text: 我们客服量最高的问题是什么?该写文章还是修产品?
say.note: 让 Claude 按联系量排序给出决策建议。

say.text: 把这篇帮助文章改成答案前置,并加上找不到答案时的下一步。
say.note: 指示调整文章结构和兜底步骤。

say.text: 整理搜索日志中零结果的查询,给出新文章标题。
say.note: 把零结果查询变成内容清单。

howto.what_en: Claude will prioritize by contact volume and search logs to write or rewrite help articles, design in-product guidance, and define maintenance and measurement plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build or fix a help center, reduce support volume, write customer documentation, or decide whether an issue deserves an article or a product fix.

say_en.text: What's our top contact issue? Article or product fix?
Rewrite this help article: answer first, then fallback steps.
Suggest titles from zero-result search queries.
